function.name: generate_speech
function.description: Convert text to a spoken audio artifact through an enabled Text to Speech provider. Specify provider to override the configured default.

provider.description: Optional provider ID. Usually omit: the administrator's configured provider is used, and this choice may be ignored.

voice.description: Optional voice/persona. Usually omit: the administrator-configured persona is used and this choice may be ignored; only approved voices are accepted and an invalid one returns the approved list. Voices are tied to the model (e.g. Gemini names like Puck, Kokoro IDs like af_heart).

model.description: Optional model. Usually omit: the administrator's configured model is used, and this choice may be ignored.

output_format.description: Requested audio format when supported by the selected provider. Defaults to the provider's native format.

speed.description: Optional speaking speed multiplier. Ignored (with a warning) if the selected provider does not support it.

instructions.description: Optional delivery/style guidance (e.g. 'cheerful, slow'). Ignored (with a warning) if the selected provider does not support it.
